description: For each pool of two total history-based binary experts, the original weighted-majority learner makes n mistakes at every horizon n on the diagonal of its exact history adapter, despite truthful feedback. At the shared horizon eleven, each expert has more than two mistakes: otherwise the imported FallibleCorrection certificate would bound learner mistakes by ten. This is the precise two-expert/budget-two comparison, not a theorem about arbitrary finite-pool error budgets or actual skepticism.
